capabilities: Activate the main workspace pane under the mouse pointer
Skip activation when the pointer passes over sidebars
Toggle the behaviour on or off via a command
Delay activation by 80 ms to reduce focus flicker at split dividers
extras: Desktop-only; it will not work on mobile. Installation is manual (copy the folder into .obsidian/plugins/), and the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian normally requires clicking a pane to activate it, so users must click before typing or using pane-specific commands.
summary: Desktop-only plugin that activates the main workspace pane under the mouse pointer after an 80 ms delay.
